_readme: Naija Trip destinations. In each quiz the FIRST option is correct (shuffled for players). lat/lon place the pin on the map.

places.name: Lekki-Ikoyi Link Bridge
places.fact: A 1.36 km cable-stayed bridge linking Lekki Phase 1 and Ikoyi, opened in May 2013. It's often called the most photographed spot in Lagos.

quiz.q: Which two areas does this bridge link?

places.name: National Theatre
places.fact: Completed in 1976 in Iganmu to host FESTAC '77, the big festival of Black and African arts. In 2024 it was renamed in honour of Wole Soyinka.

quiz.q: This building was built to host which festival?

places.name: Olumo Rock
places.fact: In the 19th century the Egba people used this rock as a natural fortress during inter-tribal wars. Abeokuta literally means 'under the rock'.

quiz.q: Which city is home to this rock?

places.name: Osun-Osogbo Sacred Grove
places.fact: A sacred forest along the banks of the Osun River, named a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2005. It hosts the yearly Osun-Osogbo festival.

quiz.q: This UNESCO World Heritage Site is in which state?

places.name: Zuma Rock
places.fact: A giant monolith beside the Abuja-Kaduna road, often called the Gateway to Abuja. Check the back of a ₦100 note and you'll see it.

quiz.q: Which naira note shows this rock?

places.name: Abuja City Gate
places.fact: Built in the early 1990s to mark the move of Nigeria's seat of government from Lagos to Abuja. It welcomes travellers coming in from the airport road.

quiz.q: Abuja officially replaced Lagos as the capital in?

places.name: Obudu Mountain Resort
places.fact: High on the Obudu Plateau, often above the clouds. Its cable car, about 4 km long, has been described as one of the longest in Africa.

quiz.q: This mountain resort is in which state?
